title: pedicularis gruina subsp. polyphylla
intro: Pedicularis gruina subsp. polyphylla, commonly known as a plant species within the Orobanchaceae family, is a type of leafy, flowering plant that obtains its nutrients by parasitizing surrounding plants. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, with reported health benefits including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pedicularis gruina subsp. polyphylla include its ability to act as an expectorant, bronchodilator, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
